messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Observability gap for tenant 'pioneer-ledger' in Dedicated pool (us-west-2). Missing traces + logs reported by customer. Severity: Sev2. Affected: trace ingestion (otel-forwarder), live metrics for tenant shard 12. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/obs/tenant-missing-traces
oncall-jen: got it — joining. any customer impact reported?
sre-ana: customer says delayed trace arrival and blank spans for requests around 11:05 PST. logs not visible in their VPC forwarder. suspected per-tenant forwarder role mismatch.
account-sam: PioneerLedger on Dedicated (pool-id: dp-88f3), VPC peer, forwarder under project 'pl-forwarder-usw2'. They tried to fetch spans and got 403 on push.
oncall-jen: can someone paste the failing log from the forwarder?
sre-ana: here's recent error from forwarder:
```
2026-03-14T18:05:12Z ERROR uploader.go:142 upload failed: status=403, body={"error":"AccessDenied","message":"role sts:AssumeRole denied for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pl-forwarder"}
```
eng-runtime: looks like the forwarder's IAM role trust is pointing to the wrong principal (old account id). Confirmed in infra state.
oncall-mike: paging infra stack leads? who can flip a fallback so customer traces show up in our central bucket while we fix role?
eng-runtime: I can stand up an ephemeral central forwarder that accepts tenant uploads and routes to central trace bucket. Quick steps:
```
# create temp forwarder
./infra/cli create-forwarder --name temp-pl-fwd --pool dp-88f3 --accept-tenant pioneer-ledger --target central-bucket
# grant assume role
aws iam update-assume-role-policy --role-name TempForwarderRole --policy-document file://trust.json
```
sre-ana: if we do that, we need to rotate keys and mark data as 'ingested-via-fallback' for audit.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: infra/forwarder:deploy  -> can promote w/ --fast
account-sam: customer notified: PioneerLedger seeing missing traces for ~10m. We'll need a customer-friendly note: 'We are ingesting your telemetry via a temporary path while we fix the role config. No data loss expected.'
customer-liaison: I'll send the message and offer a bridge at 10m intervals. prepping message now.
oncall-jen: ok eng-runtime, spin the forwarder. add me to sudo.
eng-runtime: started creating temp forwarder, attaching policy. ETA ~4m.
sre-ana: in parallel, I'm going to re-run our replay to pull missing spans from the agent buffer for tenant:
```
./scripts/replay_spans.sh --tenant pioneer-ledger --since 2026-03-14T18:00:00Z
```
oncall-mike: good. please add logs for 2026-03-14 18:00-18:15 to incident doc.
customer-liaison: message sent to PioneerLedger support alias. they replied: "Thanks — please give ETA and if PII was exposed?"
account-sam: no PII exposure. only missing observability. we'll include that.
eng-runtime: temp forwarder up. testing ingress...
eng-runtime: test push accepted, sample trace visible in central console. marking feature flag fallback:true for tenant.
sre-ana: replay finished. found 123 spans re-ingested. starting validation of trace continuity.
oncall-jen: great. update on escalation: we'll patch the assume-role trust to the correct principal and roll the forwarder role tomorrow if not blocker.
eng-runtime: patch applied: changed trust to arn:aws:sts::234567890123:assumed-role/forwarder
eng-runtime: testing real forwarder push...
eng-runtime: forwarder now accepting real customer pushes. traces show up in tenant shard 12. closing active mitigation.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied: temporary central forwarder + replayed spans. Postmortem owner: @sre-ana. Action items:
- eng-runtime: patch IaC to prevent stale principals (PR open)
- sre-ana: postmortem and incident timeline
- account-sam: customer follow-up
- infra: add alert for forwarder assume-role failures
oncall-jen: thanks team. handing to next-day oncall. assigning follow-ups.
customer-liaison: sending final update to PioneerLedger now. they asked for a short RCA when ready. :thumbsup: 
oncall-mike: marking ticket P1->P0? keep as Sev2 until RCA.
sre-ana: capturing logs and will create postmortem doc. tagging relevant owners.
